column3: A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Pre-sign-up pitch slide for a house budget app named HousePlan. Top 55%: a full-bleed cinematic photo of a timber-frame house under construction at golden hour, fading smoothly into a deep warm espresso-brown background (#1F1611). Riding the photo's lower edge: a floating cream card (#FFFBF5) showing a whole-house budget breakdown as horizontal bars by category (Structure, Roof, Kitchen, Flooring) in burnt orange (#C4561F) and soft apricot tones, with a small "Sample" tag. Below on the espresso ground: a small rounded chip with an icon, a large elegant serif headline "Plan the full house budget" in warm cream, two lines of light body text, page dots and a round burnt-orange Next button at the bottom right, Skip at top right.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Project overview dashboard for a home-building budget app. Warm cream background (#FBF4EA), deep espresso-brown (#2A1E17) headings, burnt orange (#C4561F) primary button. Top: a wide rounded photo header of a modern house exterior with the project name in white serif on a dark fade. Below: a big espresso-brown summary card with "Cash still needed" as the hero number in cream, and four small labelled figures: Estimated, Committed, Billed, Paid, with a thin burnt-orange accent line. Then a completeness meter bar in burnt orange with a marker and the line "Known subtotal - 3 unpriced lines - 2 undecided categories" with a small mustard warning dot. Then a 2-column grid of quick-action tiles on soft apricot, sand, blush and powder-blue tints with coloured icon discs (Rooms, Estimate, Quotes, Costs). Custom bottom tab bar: Projects, Calculators, Advisor, Settings, active tab in burnt orange. No green anywhere.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Flooring calculator result screen for a home-building budget app. Warm cream background (#FBF4EA), deep espresso-brown text, burnt orange accent (#C4561F). Top: a minimal architectural floor-plan drawing of a 5 m by 4 m rectangular room with thin dimension lines and arrow ticks on two sides, drawn in fine espresso lines on a faint warm grid, the floor softly hatched in pale apricot planks, a door swing arc and a window as a double line. Below: a results card listing Net area 20 m2, With 10% waste 22 m2, Packs 10, Material, Labour, and a bold total, each with a small source badge pill. A pale mustard note "Tax not included". Bottom: one full-width burnt-orange button "Add to estimate". No green anywhere.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Estimate editor screen for a house budget app. Warm cream background (#FBF4EA), deep espresso-brown text, burnt orange accent (#C4561F). Header with a project selector chip and a "Draft - revision 4" label, a large serif title "Estimate", "Known subtotal" with a big serif amount. A stacked horizontal bar shows category shares in terracotta, ochre, slate blue, plum and clay. A completeness banner in pale mustard: "Known subtotal, 3 lines need a price". Then a list grouped by category with subtotals on the right (Foundation, Structure, Roof, Openings, Electrical), each with a coloured icon disc; one line shows a dashed "Price missing" pill under its title. Bottom: a full-width espresso-brown button "Save revision". No green anywhere.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Scenario comparison screen for a home-building budget app. Warm cream background, deep espresso-brown text, burnt orange accent. Two side-by-side column cards titled "Baseline" and "Oak floors to vinyl" on soft sand and apricot tints, each with a total figure in serif; between them a small difference chip in cobalt blue showing a negative saving. Below: "What changes" rows by category with a thin diverging bar for each difference (cobalt blue for cheaper, muted rose for more expensive) around a centre line, and a tradeoffs card with two bullet notes. Bottom: a burnt-orange full-width button "Adopt scenario" and a quiet text link "Keep comparing". No green anywhere.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Subscription paywall for a home-building budget app named HousePlan. Top 35%: a warm photo of architectural drawings, a tape measure and oak flooring samples on a desk, fading into warm cream (#FBF4EA). A serif headline "Every cost of your house, in one plan" in espresso brown. Three compact benefit rows each with a coloured icon disc (terracotta, ochre, slate blue). Two plan cards side by side: Yearly (selected, with a burnt-orange border and a "Best value" tag) and Monthly. A full-width burnt-orange button "Subscribe". Fine print line "Payment starts immediately; no free trial. Auto-renews, cancel in store settings." and a row of small links "Restore - Terms - Privacy". No green anywhere.
